decisions.reader_note: For 2023–2025, Gladstone Land reports net income but a net loss attributable to common stockholders after cumulative redeemable preferred dividends and preferred-stock extinguishment adjustments. The common-stockholder loss is the EPS numerator; comprehensive income is a separate measure. The filing presents basic and diluted EPS and weighted-average common shares together. The reviewed disclosure establishes that presentation, not the cause of equal dilution measures. The heading scales dollars, not share counts: shares and EPS retain scale-zero tags.
